content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma—and gather records of your project hours. Rockford's advanced manufacturing, aerospace, healthcare, and logistics sectors all employ PMP-certified project managers; confirming eligibility now ensures you're ready to apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our online format allows Rockford professionals to learn without travel, balancing work at employers like Woodward, Collins Aerospace, Mercyhealth, or UPS with structured classroom instruction. You'll cover all five process groups and ten knowledge areas that the PMP exam tests, taught by active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Submit your project-experience documentation and educational credentials through PMI's online portal. This step formally registers you as a PMP candidate and schedules you for your exam window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. The PMP exam tests your mastery of framework, terminology, and real-world scenarios across all knowledge areas.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll hold the PMP for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or publication. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible continuing education to help you stay current and renew without retesting.
